title: Finite-stage zero detection for sections of a varying-site sheaf system
statement: Let J be a small filtered category and F : J → Cat a diagram of small categories. Let P_j be precoverages with isomorphism coverings, compositional stability, base-change stability, covering pullbacks and only finite covering presieves. Suppose every transition functor preserves coverings and covering pullbacks and is continuous, with set-valued inverse image preserving finite limits and finite colimits. Let V be a cocone whose object and arrow diagrams are set colimits. Let Q be a precoverage on V.pt with the same site axioms, whose covering presieves are exactly stage-covering images. Suppose each canonical stage functor preserves coverings and covering pullbacks and is continuous, with its set-valued inverse image preserving finite limits and finite colimits [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites]. Let e and eV be composition isomorphisms of abelian inverse images satisfying the displayed adjunction-unit equations. Let Fs_j be abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], φ_a : a^*Fs_j → Fs_k satisfy the composition cocycle with e, and S : J → Sheaf(Q,Ab) have objects canonically equal to V_j^*Fs_j and arrows equal in Arrow to eV_a followed by V_k^*(φ_a). Fix i, X_i in F_i, and t : i → j. Put X = F(t)(X_i). Let K be a colimit cocone of S [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. If the composite of the canonical inverse-image unit, the specified identification with S_j, and K.ι_j, evaluated at V_j(X), kills a section z of Fs_j at X, then there exist t′ in Under i and b : t → t′ such that the stage inverse-image unit along b.right followed by φ_(b.right), evaluated at X, kills z.

source.place: Tag 09YN; outer section colimit, followed by Tag 0A35

proof.text: Each Q-covering is a stage-covering image, whose uncurried arrow set is a subset of the image of a finite set. Thus Q has only finite coverings.

Evaluate S at the fixed limit object. The fixed-site abelian section comparison is an isomorphism from its filtered group colimit to sections of K. Its injectivity makes the class represented by the canonical-unit image of z zero.

The equality criterion for a filtered group colimit gives a stage arrow where this inverse-image section vanishes. Apply the inner inverse-image zero-detection theorem to obtain a transition in Under i killing the original section.
